Exercise A

The vocabulary list

These are all 34 words. Nothing else is tested, here or in the test — read them once, then start Exercise B.

WordWhat it means
coacha person who teaches a sports team
periodone of the equal parts of a match
to quitto stop doing something and leave it
parkoura sport of running and jumping over obstacles
dependentneeding someone else to look after you
committedready to give a lot of time and effort
to rely (on)to trust someone to help you
penaltya punishment when a player breaks a rule
demandingneeding a lot of effort and energy
disciplinethe ability to control yourself and follow rules
workouta session of hard physical exercise
to passto kick or throw the ball to a team-mate
to trainto practise a sport regularly to improve
to competeto try to beat other people or teams
to demandto ask for something in a strong way
commitmenta promise to give your time and effort
motivationthe reason why you want to do something
wina victory in a game or competition
determinedhaving decided to succeed, however hard it is
to involveto make someone part of an activity
reluctantnot wanting to do something
to participateto take part in an activity
livehappening now, not recorded earlier
to supportto help a person or cheer for a team
lacrossea team sport played with sticks that have nets
spirita strong feeling of energy and unity in a group
at its bestas good as it can possibly be
by the waywords you use to add something you just thought of
moodthe way you feel at a particular time
mana word you say when you are surprised or annoyed
to be done withto have finished doing or using something
instead ofin place of something else
to be sick of sthto be tired of something and want it to stop
as long asonly if; on the condition that
